rubric.role_summary: Onsite electrical build technician assembling and testing battery packs and distributed battery storage systems on a manufacturing production line in Austin.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Onsite electrical build technician assembling and testing battery packs and distributed battery storage systems on a manufacturing production line in Austin.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 1+ years of professional experience in a related field with electronics or mechanical assembly.
- Hands-on experience building, debugging, testing, and validating electrical systems using oscilloscopes, multimeters, and similar tools.
- Experience with common hand and power tools.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Prior experience in manufacturing, assembly, construction, or a warehouse environment.
- Familiarity with solar arrays as input power sources.
- Familiarity with lithium-ion battery handling, safety, and usage.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Austin, TX area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
